baseline.objective: Complete remaining non-test Explorer release delivery under the explicit user testing-stop amendment, beginning with exact source/Template/root/cutover/rollback preparation before apply.
criteria: Reusable source package, current capability/compatibility inventories and operational docs are complete; exact Template update manifest preserves neutral identity and historical initializer editions.

Every proposed or performed root adoption has an exact source/destination/preimage/overwrite/preservation manifest and separately recorded host authority; canonical knowledge/history and unrelated files stay outside the write and rollback sets.

Current normal-entry reader cutover and old-command deprecation preserve trusted CLI/helper caller meaning; retired active browser assets and retained historical resources are individually classified before any deletion.

Actual package/Template/root changes use the established owners and exact reviewed manifests; required schema, assets, notices and project-specific root configuration are included without a product-wide sync.

Provenance impacts, code/assets/config backups and rollback instructions preserve newer knowledge, proposals and history; no unrun rollback/regression/benchmark/native/participant test is represented as passed.

Local release documentation and final changed-file inventory map all original49REQ/36AT obligations to implementation, existing evidence and explicit user-waived tests, with original failures/current-byte limitations preserved.

No further test jobs, new screenshots, fixtures, test-only launches, certification exercises or test code are executed/added. Ordinary installation previews, source/caller inspection and exact file consistency are reported as such.

All non-test work is delivered within recorded authority or a concrete exact preview identifies a remaining adoption decision; no Git/external publication, unrelated propagation, automatic watcher restore or false original full-plan completion occurs.
baseline.rationale: One accountable release owner carries the existing agreed product through naturally shared packaging, exact owner-mediated distribution, adoption and docs. No competing design or new architecture is selected; concrete unsupported changes return to manager. Original test dependencies are explicitly waived by current user instruction, not passed.
protected: current accepted frontend runtime and sources
Template and active root copies until exact approved owner action
all role/Task/memory files outside own output
baseline.authority: READ-ONLY shipping/source/Template/root inspection and preparation. Write only Verification/project-knowledge-explorer-first-release/release-delivery and private temporary files. Prepare exact manifest and candidate diffs there; do NOT edit shipping source, updater/mapping, Template, root installation, configuration, watcher or canonical state in this first turn. No tests, build, fixtures, browser launch, shell --help probes of product, new screenshots or suites. Installed owner check/preview may be used only if source inspection establishes read-only semantics and current guard authority permits; label it install preview, not test.
baseline.deliverable: Exact reviewable package/Template/root/cutover/rollback manifests and staged proposed source patches; later actual implementation only after manager current-input/scope gate and host exact adoption authority.
baseline.stop: Stop at complete exact prepared manifests/patches or precise irreducible authority/capability blocker; do not apply package changes, perform any testing or self-accept. Return role-read SHA receipts promptly.
